name: kebab-actions-dropdown
title: Kebab Actions Dropdown
description: A row with a kebab button that expands its action menu inside the same card, with arrow-key navigation.

props.name: rowTitle
props.description: Title of the row the menu belongs to.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu entries: id, label, icon, danger, separator.

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Called with the item the user picked. The menu closes first.

props.name: triggerAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the kebab button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
